name: Academy
description: The now-disbanded institution whose former masters retreat to private workshops.

timeline.summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
timeline.quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

timeline.summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
timeline.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

pages_say.description: An institution of invention and innovation in Paliano that Adriana was ordered to dismantle.
The long-considered seat of knowledge and study in Paliano, now dissolved by royal decree.
The now-disbanded institution whose former masters retreat to private workshops.
